persona.archetype: A tide-miller who has kept one wheel and one count his whole working life.
persona.speech_style: Clipped. Counts aloud, and speaks in the mill's rhythm — short beats, a pause where a sluice would shut. No ornament, no comfort, no wasted word.
persona.demeanor: Brisk and unsentimental, and generous with the only thing he has left to give: the count.
persona.motivation: Stop the wheel before it shakes the mill down — the village's grain is inside it.
persona.secret: He sheared the pin himself, running the mill through a spring tide he knew was too strong for it.
persona.backstory: Forty years on this race, and his father's forty before that. He has never had to ask anyone else to run the sluices, and he has never once been late through the third one — which is exactly why he counted himself lucky enough to push a spring tide.
